Kevin: Heads-up: we’re seeing sustained egress errors from east1-b affecting GPU instance pool (p4/a100). Node-level network errs -> ~32% of GPU capacity reported degraded. Proposing zonal evacuation/drain of east1-b GPU nodes. Need owners for drains + traffic shift plan. Incident P0? :rotating_light:
Sara: Confirming. Cloud metrics: east1-b egress errors spike at 2026-03-18T20:12Z; packet drops, TCP retransmits up x10. Pod evictions for gpu-workloads started 20:14Z. Logs: `network: egress timeout 504` on kube-proxy. I'll attach short log sample.
Jason: I'll lead the drain for dedicated-gpu-pool-2 and rd-model-serving clusters in east1-b. Plan: cordon nodes -> drain pods -> failover traffic to east1-a & west1. Rolling 5-node batches to avoid cold-cache storm. Start 20:25Z. ETA 25-35m.
Jason: Commands I'll run:
```bash
kubectl get nodes -l topology.kubernetes.io/zone=east1-b -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl cordon
kubectl get nodes -l topology.kubernetes.io/zone=east1-b -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
Anita: I'll scale up east1-a dedicated pools by 30% and pre-warm KV cache. Note: autoscaler hard limit 200 GPUs in east1-a; currently 180. If we hit limit, we'll spillover to west1 which increases cross-region egress costs. Estimated incremental cost: ~$2.8k/day if spillover lasts 6h.
Kevin: Important: preserve reserved capacity for enterprise customers; route those to east1-a first. Non-critical batch jobs can switch to quantized-medium model to reduce GPU usage. Also set smart-router to prefer east1-a for reserved customers.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing update applied: 28% of production traffic rerouted from east1-b to east1-a; 4 routes updated. Canary OK. :white_check_mark:
Sara: Reminder: expect cache misses => latency +20-40% for first 1–2 minutes after each batch. Update client SDK retry/backoff per runbook step 4. Add note in Redwood Console incident tile.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket INF-4722 and added oncall rotation Jason -> Sara -> Kevin. Evac log archived.
Jason: Progress update: batch 1 done (5 nodes), drained cleanly. No spike beyond expected. Starting batch 2 now.
Anita: Started autoscale 20:30Z; east1-a now +15 GPUs, KV warmers running. Also enabling fallback quantized model for background indexing jobs.
Kevin: After batch 4 we'll re-check capacity and decide whether to keep east1-b cordoned or uncordon. If networking team estimates fix >3h, keep evacuated and trigger postmortem. Thanks team.
